measurement_definition: Dispersion between venue-specific final traded prices within the same UTC hourly bucket.
alignment_rule: Exact common UTC hourly bucket start.
missing_data_rule: No interpolation and no forward fill.
price_validity_rule: OHLC prices must be finite and strictly positive with low <= open/close <= high.
interpretation_limits: Hourly candle closes are not perfectly synchronous executable prices.
The two-venue hourly result is not the final multi-venue conclusion.
A research median is not an official benchmark.
Missing candles are never synthetically reconstructed.
